subject.title: RFC: Period-based popularity for publishers, skills, and plugins

question: Should ClawHub standardize Weekly/Monthly/All time popularity across publishers, skills, and plugins with shared temporal stats, publisher aggregation, and snapshot leaderboard pagination before shipping the UI tabs?
rationale: The code already has partial seven-day trending for skills/plugins, but publishers and monthly windows require policy choices that automation should not decide unilaterally.

options.title: Approve shared foundation first
options.body: Define scoring, attribution, low-activity behavior, and snapshot cursor semantics, then implement package, publisher, and leaderboard foundations before UI tabs.

options.title: Ship only existing trending surfaces
options.body: Keep the current skills/plugins Trending tabs and defer publisher/monthly alignment until later, accepting semantic mismatch across browse surfaces.

options.title: Narrow to documentation/spec work
options.body: Document the desired period contract in specs now and wait for a maintainer-sponsored implementation plan before changing code.

recommendation.title: Approve shared foundation first
recommendation.body: Define scoring, attribution, low-activity behavior, and snapshot cursor semantics, then implement package, publisher, and leaderboard foundations before UI tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current browse and catalog implementation history points to Patrick-Erichsen as the best available owner for the cross-surface contract decision.
